pages.text: A Mindspindle is an Arcane Gem formed from a green-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in a pampel cut.$(br2)When held, a Mindspindle magnifies the amount of experience contained within experience globes by 50%. It loses one point of charge for each experience point amplified, and can affect an un-amplified total of 800xp before needing to be recharged.

If you come into contact with a very large number of experience globes while holding a Mindspindle, you can absorb their essence instantly, instead of needing to wait for each globe to be picked up in sequence.
Mindspindles can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
